title: Scopegrain journal checkpoint line

supersedesKeyId.description: Reserved for key rotation: the previous key id sealed by the first checkpoint signed under a new key. Never emitted by this version.

sig.description: Ed25519 signature (64 bytes) over the UTF-8 bytes of JCS(checkpoint), base64-encoded.

keyId.description: sha256(publicKey SPKI DER) truncated to 16 hex chars; a convenience label, not authentication.

timestamp.description: Canonical Date.toISOString value, validated at runtime.

description: One canonical-JSON line of <paths.state>/journal/checkpoints.jsonl. Runtime validates strict monotonic checkpointSeq, the prevCheckpointDigest link (canonicalDigest of the previous checkpoint object), non-decreasing headSequence, the Ed25519 signature against <paths.state>/integrity/journal-ed25519.pub, and that the sealed headSequence/chainHead prefix is re-derivable from persisted intents. headSha256 anchors the exact head.json bytes at seal time, including transitory activeOperation/pendingOperations fields.
